sourceNote: Illustrative source excerpts only; these are not textbook passages. Concept names remain verbatim. The deterministic fallback uses the excerpt and localized check scaffolding.

steps.concept: The plasma membrane controls which substances enter and leave

anchor.excerpt: The plasma membrane surrounds the cell and controls which substances enter and leave, letting some molecules pass while blocking others.

body: The plasma membrane surrounds the cell and controls which substances enter and leave, letting some molecules pass while blocking others.
steps.studentWords: ሁሉም ንጥረ ነገሮች ወደ ሴል ይገባሉ።

check.sayItBack: “The plasma membrane controls which substances enter and leave” ላይ ከሁለቱ የትኛው እውነት ነው፣ ለምንስ? ከጽሑፉ የተጠቀሱትን ደረጃዎች አስቀምጥ፤ ካልተጠቀሱ መዋቅሩንና ተግባሩን አገናኝ።

steps.concept: The nucleus stores DNA and directs cell activities

anchor.excerpt: The nucleus sits at the centre and stores the genetic material, DNA, directing the cell activities.

body: The nucleus sits at the centre and stores the genetic material, DNA, directing the cell activities.

check.sayItBack: ሳታይ “The nucleus stores DNA and directs cell activities”ን በራስህ ቃላት ግለጽ። ከጽሑፉ የተጠቀሱትን ደረጃዎች አስቀምጥ፤ ካልተጠቀሱ መዋቅሩንና ተግባሩን አገናኝ።

steps.concept: Mitochondria release energy and make ATP

anchor.excerpt: Mitochondria release energy from food by cellular respiration to make ATP.

body: Mitochondria release energy from food by cellular respiration to make ATP.

check.sayItBack: “Mitochondria release energy.” አልክ። አጠናቅቀው፦ ይህ የሚሆነው ምክንያቱም ___. ከጽሑፉ የተጠቀሱትን ደረጃዎች አስቀምጥ፤ ካልተጠቀሱ መዋቅሩንና ተግባሩን አገናኝ።
ሳታይ “The drought reduced crop yields”ን በራስህ ቃላት ግለጽ። ጽሑፉ ከደገፈው መሠረት፣ ክስተቱንና ውጤቱን አገናኝ።

anchor.excerpt: Seasonal rainfall changes the water level of the lake.

body: Seasonal rainfall changes the water level of the lake.
steps.studentWords: Seasonal rain always changes the water level.

check.sayItBack: “Seasonal rainfall changes lake levels” ላይ ከሁለቱ የትኛው እውነት ነው፣ ለምንስ? ጽሑፉ ካቀረበ፣ ቦታውን፣ ምክንያቱንና ምሳሌውን ግለጽ።
